host: macOS 26.6.2 arm64, headless Mac reached over SSH
inputs: the 8 outputs of usual-path.json (out/*.skill.*), copied unchanged; sha256 per file below
method: scripts/run_ooxml_app_smoke.py _smoke_excel per file (Finder open, poll the frontmost Excel window through System Events, close without saving, quit), 180 s timeout. Every distinct window/button/text poll is logged in dialog_log. Two changes from the stock runner for this check: (1) its static PowerView gate is bypassed, because the only match in the Power Pivot output is a shared string ('Power View can only print one sheet at a time.') and the gate would otherwise skip opening the file; (2) the dialog poll is wrapped to log every observation.

positive_control.file: control-broken-sheet.xlsx (real-excel-chart-cf-basic.xlsx with a duplicate row 1 and an invalid cell type in sheet1)

windows=
buttons=YesNo
text=We found a problem with some content in 'control-broken-sheet.xlsx'. Do you want us to try to recover as much as we can? If you trust the source of this workbook, click Yes.

positive_control.note: proves the poll sees Excel's repair prompt on this host. The stock runner's keyword list does not match this prompt text, so it reports a timeout rather than a repair dialog; the log shows the prompt
